summary: Fixed the billing package so it follows docs/: leap-year February, period starts computed from the anchor, inclusive used days, tier parsing and selection by integer minimum, exponent-aware and ordered discounts with strict value validation, largest-remainder allocation, exact (Fraction) rounding and invoice-mode tax, credit-request state isolation, and a more robust run command. All 82 unit tests pass and tools/reconcile.py reports all checks agree.
